open_questions.description: What analyses to start doing on the word transcripts once Mari, Katrin and Jeff are visiting
Whether to generate meeting minutes from the recordings, and who in the group would do it given the technical subject matter
How to evaluate whether a generated summary is any good, given there are several different ways to measure it

notes: Three open questions and nothing else. Most of the case is a conference debrief about a Microsoft talk on data scaling versus choice of learning machine -- other people's results, discussed with interest and no bearing on this group's plan, so none of it is a decision, risk or action. me011's criticism that Microsoft assumed web text is correct (seg-0054) is a critique of someone else's method, not a threat to this project, and recording it as a risk would be the easy mistake here.
